name: @kittyx/thistle
description: The base TypeScript kernel in the KITTYX family.

scripts.build: bun run guards && rm -rf build && bun --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json && for dir in build/src/*; do ln -s "src/${dir##*/}" "build/${dir##*/}"; done
scripts.test:memory: bun test --timeout 60000 src/test/kernel-memory.test.ts src/test/native-image-lifetime.test.ts src/test/native-guest-access.test.ts src/test/native-host-map.test.ts src/test/native-vfork.test.ts
scripts.test:vfs: bun test --timeout 60000 src/test/native-vfs-syscall.test.ts src/test/native-vfs-edit.test.ts src/test/native-vfs-backing.test.ts src/test/native-vfs-resolve.test.ts src/test/native-vfs-mount.test.ts
scripts.test:process: bun test --timeout 60000 src/test/native-process-reap.test.ts src/test/native-process-state.test.ts src/test/native-credentials.test.ts src/test/native-process-attach.test.ts src/test/native-process-host.test.ts src/test/native-signals.test.ts
scripts.test:host: bun test --timeout 60000 src/test/net-boundary.test.ts src/test/host-rv64.test.ts src/test/host-backing.test.ts src/test/host-native-access.test.ts src/test/host-bytes.test.ts src/test/host-process.test.ts src/test/host-lifecycle.test.ts src/test/host-input.test.ts src/test/host-linux-events.test.ts src/test/host-inode.test.ts src/test/host-restore.test.ts src/test/host-mount.test.ts src/test/host-descriptor.test.ts src/test/host-file-descriptor.test.ts src/test/host-carrier-descriptor.test.ts src/test/host-path-open.test.ts src/test/host-device.test.ts src/test/host-root.test.ts
